owner: Q-LINK (el1015-qwen-link.log); die integration: KV die lead (el1014-qwen-split-kvsys.log), compute die lead (el1014-qwen-split-compute.log)
rule: no stubs / ties: every net below lands on a real RTL port; PLL and PHY analog are the only behavioural models (qkd_pll_analog_model, ot_qkvd_ucie_x64_phy_model, SerDes analog)

kv_die.qkd_d2d_static.ck: qkd_pll_analog_model core trunk (pll_c, 833.333 ps) through the die clock tree, delivered phi - R at the single entry (one CTS root incl. the 4 slot-store SRAMs)
kv_die.ot_qkvd_ucie_x64_phy.clk: same core trunk (mesochronous 1.2 GHz domain, no CDC in our logic)
kv_die.qkd_host_root_integrated.ck_records: same core trunk (record_* faces are timed by the D2D end)
kv_die.qkd_host_root_integrated.ck_phy[7:0], ck: qkd_pll_analog_model.pll_phy (1043 ps SerDes family), per-root entries

compute_die.qfd_d2d_static.ck: compute core clock = forwarded pll_fwd received by qfd_clkrx (bump pair beside the UCIe macro)

kv_die.qkd_d2d_static.por_n: die POR pin (same net as qkd_pll_analog_model.por_n, HOST por_n)
kv_die.qkd_d2d_static.rst_n: HOST link_rst_n (HOST reset sequencer, released after pll_locked; single sequencer, no second qkd_rstseq)
kv_die.bumps: qkd_d2d_static.fwd_epoch / fwd_link_rst_n -> two bumps beside qkd_ckbump -> compute die qfd_d2d_static.fwd_epoch / fwd_link_rst_n (BUMP = 3 registered stages each side, RTL parameter)

compute_die.qfd_d2d_static.rst_n: forwarded die reset from the qkd_ckbump reset bump (HOST link_rst_n, re-synchronised in qfd_clkrx)
compute_die.ot_qkvd_ucie_x64_phy.rst_n (compute): qfd_d2d_static.phy_rst_n (= own recovery reset AND forwarded link reset)

host.qkd_d2d_static.host_link_reset_req: HOST lifecycle link_reset_request (= recovery_active && all links drained; root wire peer_reset_request) -- NOT YET A ROOT OUTPUT: q_control_host must export it
host.qkd_d2d_static.host_recovery_clear: HOST recovery_complete (root output, 1-cycle pulse after the reset/retrain witnesses)
host.qkd_d2d_static.host_boot_begin: HOST boot_go (root output, level; the end starts epoch 1 on its rising edge, RTL edge detect in ot_qwen_d2d_recovery)
host.qkd_d2d_static.serdes_up: SerDes PHY up (same net as HOST phy_up)
host.HOST link_up[5:0]: bit0 = qkd_d2d_static.link_up[0] (D2D), bit1 = link_up[1] (SerDes); bits 5:2 have no link end on this die -> q_control_host: NL 6 -> 2 or name the 4 ends
host.HOST native_links_drained / native_link_: qkd_d2d_static outputs of the same names
host.HOST physical_fault[7:0]: NOT a link output: KV die lead (PHY/package fault collector)

sequencers.qfd_d2d_static.cal_start / cal_seg: compute ROM sequencer: cal_seg 1 at token start (token run = terminal RESULT + embedding row + L0), cal_seg 0 at L1..L35 starts (program_calendar/calendar.json cal_starts)
sequencers.qkd_d2d_static.cal_start / cal_seg: KV sequencer, same compiled cycles (OFS 0 in the program calendar)
sequencers.cfg_tx_we / cfg_rx_we / cfg_addr[5:0] /: each die's control-image loader in init/recovery mode: 32 entries per calendar + segment-1 base at cfg_addr[5]=1 (program_calendar/cal_*.memh, cal_*_seg1.memh)

embedding.qkd_d2d_static.emb_tx_slot/emb_tx_v/emb_: KV die embedding provider (q_native_embedding): staged row word one edge after its slot; row staged by token-run cycle 196 (179-cycle HBM budget after the token id reaches the KV HOST at cycle 17)

phy_latency: the compiler uses the trained FDI-to-far-FDI latency PHY as a constant (deterministic-latency mode); the program calendar is compiled at PHY 5 (typical); 3 / 9 compile to the same entry counts (sensitivity in COLLECT)
